_comment: Transcribed from in-game screenshots taken 2026-08-18, the day 1.4.2.0 went live (Steam captures 20260818125336 NATO art, 125340 NATO loadout, 125343 Pax Armata loadout, then 125348-125417 for the slot screens). Every slot screen was read on the Pax Armata airframe. The page leads with the in-game class name, which is the title the vehicle screen shows; the model designation rides underneath.
name: Multirole Jet
_traits_note: The pill row printed under the class name on the vehicle screen. The other eleven vehicles carry the same row in game and it was simply not recorded when they were captured, so its absence there is a gap and not a difference.

description.text: This multirole fighter is a flexible aircraft capable of both aerial dogfights and ground troop support.

options.name: API Cannon
options.description: Cannon loaded with Armor Piercing Incendiary rounds, best used against aircraft and other light vehicles.

options.name: APHEI Cannon
options.description: Cannon loaded with Armor-Piercing High-Explosive Incendiary rounds effective against most targets, though its lower muzzle velocity makes engaging fast-moving targets more challenging.

options.name: Lock-Guided
options.title: Lock-Guided AA Missile
options.description: Locks on or utilizes laser guidance to target any aircraft.

options.name: Auto-Guided
options.title: Auto-Guided AA Missile
options.description: Anti-radiation missile which homes in on vehicles with anti-air missile weapon systems. Damage temporarily jams struck targets. Effective against surface targets and slow-moving aircraft

options.name: Heavy Rockets
options.description: Unguided rockets capable of firing smaller volleys but providing higher damage per projectile. Effective against most vehicles including armored targets.

options.name: Cluster
options.title: Anti-Armor Cluster Bomb
options.description: Cluster bomb which dispenses numerous anti-armor submunitions over a target location.

options.name: Directional Jammer
options.description: Targets handheld and vehicle mounted enemy devices to prevent lock-on against the jet or other vehicles. Extended use will temporarily overheat the equipment.

options.name: Active-Lock
options.title: Active-Lock AA Missile
options.description: Air-to-air missile designed to engage enemy aircraft. User must maintain sight lock until impact.

options.name: Bomb
options.title: Precision Penetration Bomb
options.description: A large aerial bomb that will guide itself to the targeting crosshair position at the time of release. Capable of penetrating subsurface structures.

options.name: Optic-Guided
options.title: Optical Missile
options.description: Precison munition controlled by optical feed, allowing for mid-flight adjustments. Primarily for armored ground targets, but can be used creatively against structures, infantry, and aircraft.

_loadout_note: Seven slots, and no Upgrade slot on either seat - every other jet has a Driver Upgrade. Recorded as seen: the loadout row was captured whole on both factions and shows four Driver tiles and three Gunner tiles with nothing cut off. Two Gunner slots share the name Remote Weapon, which is the same shape the Attack Helicopter, Scout Helicopter and Patrol Boat already use; they hold different options and are recorded separately, in the order the row prints them. Both Flares tiles are name-only and marked locked: Flares is fixed and not customisable, confirmed by the project owner from play on 2026-08-18, which matches every other aircraft in the database.
_transcription_note: Two in-game strings are reproduced exactly as printed rather than corrected: the Auto-Guided AA Missile description ends without a full stop, and the Optical Missile description spells it "Precison". Same rule the patch log follows for EA's own typos - keep the wording, never quietly fix it.
_designation_note: The Directional Jammer prints a designation line that simply repeats its name. It is recorded because it was printed: this is a Remote Weapon slot, and weapon slots are exactly where designations appear. The two Equipment tiles that were opened, Heavy Rockets and Cluster, print no designation, which matches the rule that equipment slots have none.
_variant_note: Both factions field the same model here; only the livery differs, so the two captures show one aircraft in NATO and Pax Armata colors. The same is true of the Transport Helicopter and the Patrol Boat.
_image_note: Cropped from the Customize screen (Steam captures 20260818175013 NATO, 20260818175010 Pax Armata), not the Cosmetic Customization screen the other eleven vehicles use, because no capture of that screen exists for these two. Consequences, so nobody wonders later: the frame is 1500x422 rather than the 1500x780 the rest share, because the only band clear of the header, the callout and the loadout row is that shallow; and a faint callout leader line and the small square hardpoint reticle sit on the airframe, since both are drawn over the aircraft and no crop removes them. Both figures on a page use one geometry so they match each other. Nothing was painted out - cropping is framing, retouching would be inventing. Replace these if the Cosmetic Customization screen is ever captured.
